record_title: Sharp lower area profile and reverse stability for cyclic quadrilaterals
limitations: Nondegenerate convex cyclic Euclidean quadrilaterals only. Above normalized side variance q=4/3 the lower value is a limiting infimum. The upper-product counterpart and the opposite sharp deficit inequality are prior work. Equivalent older symmetric-polynomial or geometric-inequality formulations may exist, so originality is to the best of our knowledge.
